Definition: to chase; by implication, to desolate
BiblicalUsage: tsâdâh is used for to chase. It appears 3 times in Scripture, including Exodus 21:13 and 1 Samuel 24:11.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsâdâh reminds me that God's Word is exact down to the word, not only in the great themes.
